ol.li: A workspace admin chooses what it covers: this project or the whole workspace.
Choose the target — a single agent or a crew.
Pick the kind and its schedule/event settings.
Write the prompt template — the prompt each run starts with. Keep it lean; the agent fetches artifact content itself at run time.

conbody.p: Automations are created enabled; toggle them on/off from the table at any time. The table also shows each automation's last run and (for scheduled ones) the next run time. If a scheduled automation's cron expression can no longer be read, it is not run: it is switched off, so correct its schedule and switch it back on.
